why_required: Native evidence must state exact runtime baseline
artifact_or_note: S2 artifact must include command path, FreeCAD version/revision, OCCT or LibPack if available, platform, script path, cwd and timestamp; no parity decision without baseline.

why_required: Disabled, Enabled, Mutated and PartialLoad must be separated
artifact_or_note: S2 artifact must enumerate Disabled control, Enabled, property-change-to-Mutated, explicit Mutated and PartialLoad True with separate expected gate and diagnostics per mode.
S2 artifact must record zero, one and multi-support setup result; only exactly one support and non-Disabled may enter CopyOnChange, with cleanup observed where possible.

why_required: FreeCAD uses temporary binder during copied-object update
artifact_or_note: S2 artifact must record _tmp_binder creation, cleanup, visibility and request-local observability while keeping temporary document handles rejected for DTO.

why_required: _CopiedObjs must expose stable copied object identities
artifact_or_note: S2 artifact must record source object names/ids to copied object names/ids plus _CopiedObjs order and lifetime; missing identity remains blocker.

why_required: copyObject dependency order is core graph evidence
artifact_or_note: S2 artifact must record dependency list/order from copyObject, included dependencies, dependency edges if observable and export/import copy result order.

why_required: Copied support must rewrite links to copied objects
artifact_or_note: S2 artifact must record Support sublist before/after and _CopiedLink target/subvalues; no frontend prefix guessing or label-only proof.
S2 artifact must record first recompute before property copy, second recompute after property copy when triggered, success/failure signal and copyerror class.

why_required: ElementMap and NamedShape lifecycle decides whether DTO can carry topo evidence
artifact_or_note: S2 artifact must record ElementMap/NamedShape evidence before copy, after first recompute, after property copy and after binder result; S3 may approve request-local evidence only.

why_required: PartialLoad is visible input but depends on copied graph lifecycle
artifact_or_note: S2 artifact must record PartialLoad True behavior with canLoadPartial and Support.setAllowPartial and whether copy path requires fully-loaded source before S3 decides.

why_required: Cache_* must stay optimization unless native evidence proves semantic state
artifact_or_note: S2 artifact must record Cache_* creation, hit and removal and classify it as transform optimization unless FreeCAD evidence proves semantic copied graph state.
